title: ImageneBio, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: ImageneBio, Inc., a micro-cap biotech company on the Nasdaq Capital Market (ticker: IMA), filed an 8-K announcing a $30 million private placement via pre-funded warrants to institutional and accredited investors. The company intends to use proceeds for late-phase development in atopic dermatitis and expansion of IMG-007 into alopecia areata.
key_points: ImageneBio entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement on April 12, 2026 for a private placement of pre-funded warrants.
Pre-funded warrants to purchase 5,770,335 shares at $5.199 per share, generating approximately $30 million in gross proceeds.
Exercise price of pre-funded warrants is $0.001 per share, exercisable immediately and without expiration until exercised in full.
Registration Rights Agreement requires SEC registration statement for resale of warrant shares by August 1, 2026.
Net proceeds to support atopic dermatitis development and IMG-007 expansion into alopecia areata.
